title: Estate Buyer's Terms Sheet: Outright Purchase, Consignment and the Metal Holding Period
content:
Under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes a piece may, on the programmes that offer it, be bought outright by the chain for a published share of its appraised value, or offered on consignment for a published period against a published commission. The terms sheet below carries the figures for every programme, together with the number of days a bought-in piece is held before it is resold or melted.

## Terms

| Programme | Outright purchase offered | Share of the appraised value paid on outright purchase | Consignment commission | Consignment period (calendar days) | Smallest appraised value taken on consignment (USD) | Days a bought-in piece is held before resale or melting |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | yes | 35 percent | 0 percent | 0 | 0 | 15 |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | no | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 | 0 | 15 |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | no | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 | 0 | 15 |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | no | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 | 0 | 15 |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | no | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 | 0 | 15 |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | yes | 52 percent | 22 percent | 120 | 4999 | 30 |

A consignment period of 0 and a consignment floor of 0 mean the programme does not take pieces on consignment.

## Hypothetical illustration

Suppose a piece is appraised at 8000 USD and offered under the Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme. An outright purchase would pay 52 percent of 8000 USD, which is 4160 USD. On consignment the piece would be offered for 120 calendar days, and the chain would retain 22 percent of whatever price it achieved; on a sale at 8000 USD that retention would be 1760 USD. The same piece offered under the Belrose Standard Trade-In could be bought outright for 35 percent of 8000 USD, which is 2800 USD, and could not be consigned at all.

## Notes

- The estate programme's consignment floor of 4999 USD is an appraised value; a piece appraised at 4999 USD reaches it, and one appraised at 4998 USD does not.
- The metal holding period is 15 days under five programmes and 30 under the Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme.
